pages: Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, stands in a cold dark paddock holding one brass tally counter in both hands at his chest, chin tipped back to the sky. Middle distance: a wire fence, a straw bale. Background: a clear star field, a low black range.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, stands alone at the fence turning one brass tally counter over and over in his hands, brows drawn together in thought. Middle distance: a straw bale, frost in the grass. Background: the dark paddock and a thick scatter of stars.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, sits on a straw bale at the fence, knees pulled up, one brass tally counter gripped tight in his fist, face lifted. Middle distance: a wire fence. Background: thin meteor scratches low in the north-east, one faint green wash across the paddock.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, stands in first light turning the knurled key of one brass tally counter to read its five steel drums. Middle distance: a small open notebook, a pencil on the fence post. Background: the sky gone pale behind a low black range.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, sits at a kitchen table with one open notebook pushed in front of him, columns ruled down the paper, his hands flat beside it and his eyes down. Middle distance: a cold mug. Background: a small window of grey morning light.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, walks down a dark hillside track away from the paddock, one small notebook held to his chest, his other hand loose, head down. Middle distance: fence posts, tussock grass. Background: the farmhouse window below, and a wide cold sky.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, stands at the fence in the grey before dawn, one brass tally counter held out flat in his open palm, jaw set. Middle distance: a straw bale, flattened grass. Background: a paling eastern sky over a black range.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, sits on the straw bale with one brass tally counter held ready in his hand, eyes fixed on the north-east, mouth open to call a streak he has seen. Middle distance: the fence rail. Background: quick thin scratches over the dark sky.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, sits on the straw bale with one notebook open flat on his knees and one finger tracing the ruled lines. Middle distance: the brass tally counter set beside him. Background: a fading star field and first grey on the horizon.

Ben Halloran, a boy of eleven, short dark hair, a navy blue wool jumper over a grey shirt, stands on the track with one notebook open in his left hand and a pencil in his right, head turned up to a pale meteor train hanging. Middle distance: the fence rail. Background: a black sky with grey at its edge.
